banner.heading: 76% of NGOs in the U.S. and 60% in LATAM fail to scale. Without them, entire communities are left vulnerable.
banner.bodyStart: Social organizations do not just help — they
banner.bodyMid: Without access to funding, structure and strategic support, many disappear, leaving thousands without the help they need.
banner.bodyBold2: SIGUE NETWORK exists to change this reality.
banner.ctaSub: how SIGUE drives the growth of organizations that transform communities.
banner.imageAlt: Diverse group of people with arms around each other looking toward the horizon

desafio.descStart: Too many organizations with the potential to transform communities struggle to grow due to lack of resources, structure and visibility. These challenges are greater for those serving Hispanic communities in the U.S. and LATAM, and intensify for those whose work is grounded in faith.
desafio.descBold: Our mission is to change this reality.

funding.title: Lack of funding
funding.body: Limited resources and intense competition for donations. (only 1% of donations go to Latino communities and only 3% to faith-based organizations)

impact.title: Pressure to demonstrate impact
impact.body: Demand for tangible metrics to justify financial support.

sustainability.title: Operational sustainability
sustainability.body: Lack of internal structure that hinders expansion.

visibility.title: Low visibility and ineffective communication
visibility.body: Difficulty sharing their impact and attracting strategic allies.

desafio.resultText: Many NGOs operate with minimal resources, exhausting their teams and limiting their capacity for transformation.
desafio.resultEnd: and the communities they serve are left without access to essential services.

respuesta.bodyIntro: At SIGUE NETWORK, we offer a path for these organizations to overcome these barriers and achieve a sustainable impact:

strengthen.rest: their operational structure with innovative tools and strategies.

impulse.rest: their visibility so they become fundable and findable by donors and allies.

accompany.rest: their growth with expert mentorship and collaboration networks.

respuesta.closingEnd: organizations in the social impact ecosystem.

benefits.question: How do donations benefit our organization?
benefits.answer: Your donations allow us to empower nonprofit projects and organizations by funding operations and activities that create holistic impact in communities in need.

deductible.question: Are donations tax-deductible?
deductible.answer: Yes, all donations are tax-deductible, creating benefits for both you and the communities we support.

howTo.question: How can I make a donation?
howTo.answer: You can donate quickly and securely through our website. Simply click the “Make your donation here” button and follow the instructions.

specific.question: Can I support a specific project or program?
specific.answer: Of course! Contact us to choose a project or program you would like to fund directly, and we will make sure your donation is directed to that purpose.

transparency.question: How do we ensure transparency and accountability?
transparency.answer: We maintain a high standard of transparency and accountability through regular audits, detailed reports and periodic updates shared with our donors.

updates.question: How can I stay up to date with our work?
updates.answer: When you donate, you will receive exclusive updates and can join our community to follow the progress and results of our projects.

companies.question: How can companies or corporations partner with us?
companies.answer: Companies can collaborate through sponsorships, donations or corporate social responsibility programs. Contact us to explore customized partnership options.

questions.question: What if I have more questions?
questions.answer: If you have any other questions, we will be happy to help. Write to us at info@siguenetwork.org.
